preconditions.description: The currency type must be either 'USD' or 'EUR'.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(values_list, list) and all(isinstance(x, float) for x in values_list)
preconditions.description: The input values must be a list of floats.

postconditions.description: The output list must have the same length as the input list.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) for s in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every element in the output must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all((s.startswith('$') and s.endswith('.00') or s.endswith('€')) for s in return_value)
postconditions.description: USD strings must start with '$' and EUR strings must end with '€'.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(float(s.replace('$', '').replace('€', '').replace(',', '')) - (v / 1.1363636 if to_currency == 'EUR' else v)) < 0.005 for v, s in zip(values_list, return_value))
postconditions.description: Each output string represents the converted amount (divided by 1.1363636 for EUR, unchanged for USD) rounded to two decimal places.
